guards.what: EntropyPower.cs:31 the transform rolls on Rng.CombatCardSelection
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 6): the transform rolls on CombatCardSelection. `CardCmd.TransformToRandom(item, RunState.Rng.CombatCardSelection)` (EntropyPower.cs:31) names the stream at the CALL site, and Entropy is the only in-combat caller, so `CardCmd.transform_to_random` in cmds.py reads `combat_rng.card_selection` instead of the shared `combat._rng`. The out-of-combat deck transformers are a different command path and are unaffected.  The text it replaced read: WRONG RNG STREAM. C# threads player.RunState.Rng.CombatCardSelection into CardCmd.TransformToRandom (CardCmd.cs:323-326 -> Transform), so every replacement is drawn from the CombatCardSelection stream in a fixed order. The sim's CardCmd.transform_to_random picks with hooks.combat._rng.choice(options) (cmds.py:435), and combat._rng is the SHARED unseeded random.Random (combat.py:88), not the per-purpose accessor -- combat.combat_rng.card_selection (combat_rng.py:21,51) is the matching stream and exists. Identical defect to the one already recorded LIVE on power/aggression (report section 4 item 8), and live for the same reason: under seed parity any replay that plays Entropy diverges on the replacement card AND perturbs every later draw off the shared rng. Entropy is a ported Colorless power card (cards/colorless_powers.py:74-94), so both halves of binding rule 6 hold. The option set itself is faithful -- cards.pool.transform_options_in_combat (pool.py:212-226) is a documented port of CardFactory.GetDefaultTransformationOptions(isInCombat: true). Third-file citations, not hashed here.
